response.original_title: ⟪FAQs-to-Help⟫ How to communicate on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on an MSC cruise for free using the onboard chat feature inside the MSC for Me App while connected to the ship's Wi-Fi in airplane mode. Onboard Communication Options MSC for Me App Chat: Send free text messages to fellow travelers onboard without buying an internet package. Connect to the ship's Wi-Fi, turn on airplane mode, and add contacts by scanning a QR code or entering their name and stateroom number (chat is available for guests ages 16 and older). Stateroom Phones: Call directly between cabins by dialing the other stateroom's phone number +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)  Connecting with the Outside World Internet / Wi-Fi Packages: Purchase a paid Wi-Fi package if you need to use external messaging apps (like WhatsApp or iMessage), browse social media, or check your email. Cellular at Sea: Keep your phone in airplane mode unless you want to incur expensive satellite roaming fees from your home carrier.
